messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx rate and increased p95 latency from eu-west-1 region affecting Hosted API and several Dedicated pools. CI logs show rapid spike ~08:12 UTC. Auto-failover to neighboring region triggered for some customers. Paging oncall.
sara (oncall): acked. I'm on it. I'm looking at the metrics dashboard now — p50 fine but p95/99 up ~600ms and 5xx jump to ~8% from baseline 0.3%.
ryan (infra): seeing a corresponding spike in calls to AWS KMS Decrypt and STS AssumeRole for eu-west-1 control plane from our auth proxy. Error rate on KMS Decrypt ~12% 5xx, latency 1.5s.
miguel (dedicated-eng): dedicated pools in eu-west-1 show higher tail latencies and failures during model loading requests (Decrypt + model artifact access). Some requests hit our per-request KMS path.
sara (oncall): OK can we confirm whether this is an AWS regional control-plane degradation or a third-party throttle? Any AWS Health events?
ryan (infra): AWS Health shows intermittent elevated API error rates for KMS and STS in eu-west-1 (console shows degraded). Opening AWS support ticket now.
anne (sre): customers will see generation failures and timeouts; hosted API returns 502/503 for affected nodes. We should start customer-impact copy.
sara (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) Route new hosted traffic away from eu-west-1 where possible 2) For Dedicated pools, enable cross-region DR for at-risk customers 3) Bypass per-request KMS where safe by using cached data key for a short window 4) Increase client-side timeouts and retries carefully.
miguel (dedicated-eng): starting canary traffic shift for Dedicated pool eu-west-1 -> eu-west-2 for non-data-sensitive tenants. Applying traffic policy now.
ryan (infra): temporary config to force fallback routing applied to edge routing table for hosts with >5% 5xx. Watch for saturation in eu-west-2.
sara (oncall): anne, can you draft a short status to affected customer list? Keep it calm: explain third-party AWS degradation, mitigation steps, ETA TBD.
anne (sre): on it. Draft: "We are investigating increased errors and latency for requests served from eu-west-1 due to elevated error rates in AWS KMS/STS. We are applying routing and fallback mitigations; some requests may be routed to other regions. We will provide updates every 30 mins." Want me to send now or wait 10?
sara (oncall): send now, include workaround note for Dedicated customers to enable cross-region failover in console (link) and point to support.
anne (sre): sent: https://status.internal/redwood/incident/3356704321 — customers notified. reactions: :loudspeaker:
ryan (infra): AWS support replied: "Investigating increased error rates for KMS/STS in eu-west-1, symptoms match our telemetry. No ETA yet." Uploaded AWS health link.
miguel (dedicated-eng): rolling a hotfix to reduce KMS calls by caching DEKs in the serving runtime for 5 minutes. Patch rolling to eu-west-1 dedicated pools now.
sara (oncall): please post the command you're running so we can audit.
miguel (dedicated-eng): patch rollout command:
```bash
./deploy --service serving-runtime --region eu-west-1 --set runtime.kms.dek_cache_ttl=300
```
apply started: 3/6 pods updated in eu-west-1, checking errors.
deploy-bot: deploy started by miguel: serving-runtime/eu-west-1 patch v2026.03.15-kms-caching.
ryan (infra): I pushed a routing change to edge: traffic percentage to eu-west-1 reduced from 100% -> 40% for Hosted API prod route. Will monitor.
sara (oncall): good. Miguel/ryan — keep me posted on error rate and new 5xx fraction. anne, update customers once we see improvement or if the patch regresses.
miguel (dedicated-eng): patch succeeded on eu-west-1 nodes that received it — initial signal: KMS calls reduced ~70% for those pods, 5xx dropped locally from 10% to 1.8% on patched pods.
anne (sre): updating status: "We have applied mitigations in-region and routing changes; partial recovery observed for patched hosts. AWS reports ongoing investigation for KMS/STS in eu-west-1." sent.
sara (oncall): Ok that's progress. Next: we need a handoff scheduled in 30m. Who's staying 30m? miguel can stay for rollback if needed. ryan — please monitor cross-region capacity.
ryan (infra): watching cross-region capacity, free headroom in eu-west-2 is ~45% before autoscale; will raise early if we see >60% utilization.
miguel (dedicated-eng): leaving a short remediation note: if KMS remains flaky longer than 2h, we should consider using a customer-managed DEK rotation path (customers opt-in) or temporary local key caching for Dedicated pools with opt-out. Will write doc after incident.
sara (oncall): anne please perform on-call handoff in 30m to @ryan and @miguel if no regressions. Add summary for next oncall: root cause suspected: AWS KMS/STS regional API degradation causing per-request crypto failures and model load failures. Mitigations applied: KMS DEK caching in serving runtime, traffic shift to eu-west-2, temporary increase in retries, customer notifications.
anne (sre): handoff note saved in incident channel. Also attached quick runbook steps: how to force traffic shift, rollback deploy, revoke DEK cache if needed.
ryan (infra): AWS updated status: partial recovery observed for KMS in eu-west-1 ~08:52 UTC. Error rates dropping but still above baseline. They're continuing throttling mitigation.
sara (oncall): monitoring p95 and 5xx. current p95 eu-west-1 -> 220ms (was 600ms), 5xx -> 1.2% (was 8%). Good. Keep customers updated every 30m until fully resolved.
anne (sre): customers replied thanking for quick mitigation; some enterprise customers asked for post-mortem and impact window. Noted.
sara (oncall): start summarizing timeline for postmortem: initial spike 08:12 UTC, AWS KMS/STS errors observed 08:14, routing + caching mitigations started 08:22, partial recovery 08:52, monitor until stable.
miguel (dedicated-eng): leaving notes for postmortem: quantify requests impacted, number of dedicated pools rerouted, list customers opted in to cross-region. I'll collect logs and DEK cache metrics.
anne (sre): preparing customer impact table now.
sara (oncall): ok team — I'm going to hand off active monitoring to ryan in 30m. Thanks everyone. If anything regresses ping here.
ryan (infra): ack. standing by.
incident-bot: Reminder: oncall handoff scheduled at 09:02 UTC."
